body.statement: Under equation (13), positive selected conditional probabilities, and Conditions 2--3 of Shingaki--Yoshida--Kuroki (2026), with an instrument having at least three levels and a proxy having at least three levels, Corollary 1 identifies the conditional counterfactual probabilities and hence PN and PS from the selected observed law in the instrumental-variable-plus-proxy design.

source.verbatim_statement: if Conditions 2 and 3 of Theorem 1 and equation (13) hold, both the PN and the PS are identifiable from the statistical data in the presence of confounding and selection biases

attestation.note: Exact prose transcribed from the PMLR publisher PDF at Section 3.2 immediately before Corollary 1, p. 3516; equation (13) and the full Corollary 1 statement were checked there.
